scripts.dev:staging: if [ ! -f .env.staging.local ]; then echo 'Missing .env.staging.local. Copy .env.staging.example first.'; exit 1; fi; pnpm --parallel --filter api --filter web run dev:staging
scripts.dev:production: if [ "$ALLOW_PRODUCTION_DEBUG" != "true" ]; then echo 'Refusing to connect local code to production. Re-run with ALLOW_PRODUCTION_DEBUG=true.'; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -f .env.production.local ]; then echo 'Missing .env.production.local. Copy .env.production.example first.'; exit 1; fi; echo 'WARNING: local code is connected to PRODUCTION data and storage.'; pnpm --parallel --filter api --filter web run dev:production
scripts.validate:deployment:staging: pnpm --filter api run validate:deployment:staging && pnpm --filter web run validate:deployment:staging
scripts.validate:deployment:production: pnpm --filter api run validate:deployment:production && pnpm --filter web run validate:deployment:production
